input.instruction: Complete a move-review request. An explicitly unsupported destination requires staff review even when all address/date details are supplied; do not list known unsupported facts as missing. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I am leaving 7 Hazel Crescent, Cedarbridge, US for 42 Linden Quay, Unit 6, Larkport, Canada. Move my coverage on December 1, 2026.
Do you want both homes covered during an overlap?
No overlap. I hand back the old keys November 30. But I do not want the old policy canceled before staff confirm what can be arranged.
This product serves US addresses. Should I substitute your sister's US mailing address as the insured home?
No. My insured home would actually be the Canadian apartment. I am not asking to insure my sister's home.
Should the document record the complete Canadian destination and send the move question for staff review?
Yes. I confirm 42 Linden Quay, Unit 6, Larkport, Canada and December 1, 2026 as my request. Please do not treat that as consent to cancel the existing policy.

requested_destination.description: Actual requested insured destination, copied exactly; do not substitute a mailing address.

destination_country.description: Country explicitly supplied for the proposed insured premises.

simultaneous_homes_requested.description: True for requested simultaneous insurance of both homes; false for expressly no overlap.

cancellation_consented.description: True for explicit current cancellation consent; false if expressly withheld.

routing.description: staff_review_outside_service_area means an explicitly non-US insured home; ordinary_move means an otherwise supported US move.
